messages:
Priya (CS): Quick sync — Blueleaf renewal is 6/5. They asked to switch payment method from CC to ACH and push to net60. details below, need signoff from finance + legal before sending updated quote.
Tom S: I chatted with their procurement lead yesterday — ACH is fine but they need net60 on the amended term. CC was originally in the contract.
Lin (Finance): net60 + ACH ok from our side but we need a signed amendment referencing the payment instructions. Also need to confirm VAT handling (EU customer).
Jordan Legal: Flag — current MSA auto-renews unless a termination notice; changing payment terms requires an amendment. Can we get a one-paragraph amendment instead of re-issuing full contract?
Priya (CS): Yes, customer prefers minimal paperwork. They want seats activated on 6/6 but will only clear ACH by ~6/10. Is there a way to provision with a soft hold until funds clear?
Aisha Ops: We can provision with a billing hold flag. We require signed amendment + payment instruction to enable production keys. Ops will set billing_hold=true until confirmed.
Tom S: I'll prepare the amendment. Question: should we include a clause for late fee after 15 days? Customer balked at penalties so probably no.
Jordan Legal: Skip penalties. Add a clause: "payment due within 60 days; failure to pay may result in suspension after 30 days" — softer and acceptable. I'll draft suggested language.
Lin (Finance): Also need their ACH details and an expected payment date. If they want invoicing on 6/6 with due 8/5 we'll record that. Also confirm billing contact + tax ID for VAT.
Tom S: I'll ping procurement (cc: @Procurement Lead). I have their billing contact: emma@blueleaf.com and tax ID is pending.
Priya (CS): Action items: 1) Jordan to draft amendment text, 2) Tom to collect ACH + tax ID + PO (if they want PO), 3) Lin to confirm invoicing flow and whether we can accept ACH net60, 4) Aisha to prepare provisional provisioning process.
Jordan Legal: Drafted amendment here (quick snippet):
```
Amendment: Parties agree to modify Section 4 (Payment) — Customer shall pay via ACH within 60 days of invoice. No late fee; Provider may suspend services after 30 days past due. This Amendment is effective upon signature of authorized reps.
```
I'll convert to DocuSign-ready doc.
DocuSign Bot: Signature request queued for Blueleaf (emma@blueleaf.com). Link: https://docusign.example/req/ABC123 :white_check_mark:
Tom S: Sending the updated quote now with amendment attached. Will request PO if they prefer — tracking number Q-5582.
Lin (Finance): Confirmed: invoicing on 2026-06-06, due 2026-08-05, method ACH. Please include VAT field; we'll apply reverse charge if they provide VAT ID.
Priya (CS): Great. One more ask from customer: brief enablement session after activation. I can schedule a 30m onboarding call for 6/11.
Aisha Ops: Noted — once payment clears and amendment signed, Ops will flip billing_hold -> active and send seat invite.
Tom S: I'll follow up with procurement for ETA on ACH transfer (they said target 6/10). Will update thread when I have the PO/ACH details.
Priya (CS): Thanks team — feel free to react here for status. I'll keep customer updated: "amendment in progress, signature sent, provisioning pending cleared payment" :thumbsup:
Jordan Legal: Reviewed and signed.
DocuSign Bot: Blueleaf (emma@blueleaf.com) signed 2026-06-03 14:12 UTC.
Lin (Finance): Payment posted 2026-06-10 09:04 UTC. VAT ID provided: EU-678901.
Aisha Ops: Billing hold removed, seats activated, onboarding invite sent for 2026-06-11 10:00 UTC.
Priya (CS): Closing loop — renewal executed with ACH net60, amendment signed, onboarding scheduled. Closing this thread. :party-parrot:
